$comment: Deployed sites probed by `npm run security:surface`. Probes are GET, HEAD and OPTIONS only. protectedPath is a path that refuses an anonymous request (a redirect to login, 401 or 403); it is used to check that an x-middleware-subrequest header does not skip the auth check (CVE-2025-29927). Leave protectedPath null when the site has none. Each URL was confirmed to resolve on 2026-10-24.
